identity.gate_semantics: identical to v4/v5; no threshold moved

selection_formula.eligibility: exposure >= 10 vehicles in every variant and window
selection_formula.eligibility_rationale: the ranking signal (high-low)/high approaches 1 as low approaches 0, so strict positivity alone selects edges that are nearly unused in their quietest window; the floor keeps one vehicle below a tenth of the least-exposed window
selection_formula.expected_discriminating: the top two by that ranking
selection_formula.inputs: canonical archived demand routes and tracked topology only
selection_formula.not_a_prediction: a selection signal only; it does not guarantee a 300-second SUMO objective spread
selection_formula.ranking: mean relative temporal range, then median support, then edge id
selection_formula.raw_evidence: each selected case records schedule_ids and the q10/q50/q90 vehicle exposure for every one of those windows, in the same order
selection_formula.recomputation: per variant let low=min(window_exposure) and high=max(window_exposure); temporal_variation = mean over q50,q10,q90 of (high-low)/high, rounded to 6dp; median_support = median over variants of median(window_exposure), rounded to 3dp; min_support = min over variants of low; eligibility requires low>=10 everywhere

topology_rules.excludes: every v1-v5 edge, its reverse and shared-junction neighbours
